messages:
carmen: dropping a quick thread about the SLO guardrail copy + pool recommendation chip. protos in Figma: https://figma.com/file/slo-guardrail

li: skimmed. first thought: the recommendation chip reads too prescriptive: 'Use reserved-high.' users asked for reasons. can we add a 1-line rationale in the tooltip?

sara: yes. suggestion: tooltip: 'Reserved-high offers more throughput for low p95 targets (fewer retries).' keeps it concrete.

ben: also the green checkmark on recommendations is confusing when we show multiple ranked pools. maybe use numeric rank (1/3) instead of a checkmark so it's clear it's a suggestion, not an enforced choice.

carmen: good point. ranking + confidence badge could help: '1 · high confidence'.

li: accessibility: confidence badges currently use green/yellow/red only. please include text 'High / Medium / Low' and patterned BG for colorblind users.

sara: keyboard behavior: the recommendation chip opens a mini-panel with reasons. ensure focus goes into the panel and back to the chip on close. prototype currently traps focus poorly.

eval-bot: quick lint: contrast fail on .rec-chip-text at 12px; mini-panel missing aria-describedby linking to the SLO rationale; ranking lacks accessible name.

ben: copy tweak for main guardrail banner: current 'SLO too aggressive for selected pool' -> change to 'Target p95 latency may exceed pool capacity'. clearer and less alarmist.

carmen: agree. microcopy for the rationale list in the panel: 1) throughput limit vs requested concurrency, 2) historical tail latency on pool, 3) cost impact estimate. Each line should be short.

li: cost estimate: show absolute delta first, then percent. e.g. '$210/month (+14%)'. screen reader version spelled out: 'two hundred ten dollars per month, fourteen percent increase.'

sara: also we should show a one-click 'Apply suggested config' that opens a small diff: 'Min 2→4, Max 8→16, Enable burst' so users see what changes. add a small undo affordance after apply.

ben: for experiments: can we add an opt-in 'Auto-suggest' toggle in settings so heavy users don't see recommendations? product asked for that earlier.

carmen: yep, will include an account-level toggle. default on for new users, but configurable.

eval-bot: accessibility reminder: all dynamic updates must have aria-live polite summaries. e.g. 'Pool recommendations updated: primary suggestion reserved-high, confidence high.'

li: visual: the pool selector needs a compact badge that shows headroom percentage and estimated p95 at target load. e.g. 'Headroom 62% · est p95 120ms'. keep it single line.

sara: SR variant: 'Headroom sixty-two percent. Estimated p ninety-five one hundred twenty milliseconds.' speak numbers clearly.

carmen: action items: 1) update recommendation chip to numeric rank + confidence text + patterned bg, 2) change guardrail banner copy to Ben's wording, 3) add rationale panel with three bullets and $ delta first, 4) implement focus trap + aria-live summaries, 5) add account-level Auto-suggest toggle. i'll push updated frames as 2123456802.

ben: I'll prototype the diff UX and undo toast behavior. aim to keep rollback one-click and logged to activity feed.

li: I'll run a11y pass after the new frames. also pls attach contrast screenshots.

sara: once frames updated, I'll test keyboard nav and SR copies. thanks team :raised_hands:
